Sandbox_CookAndSortRange_Radius_tooltip: AutoCook and Manage Containers use the containers within this distance on the same floor. The character walks to each one to take or put away the items.
Sandbox_CookAndSortRange_AutoCook_toolti: AutoCook takes ingredients from the containers within the radius and puts the unused ones back.
Sandbox_CookAndSortRange_ManageContainer: Put in assigned containers uses the configured containers within the radius.
Sandbox_CookAndSortRange_Appliance: AutoCook cooks in the oven or microwave
Sandbox_CookAndSortRange_Appliance_toolt: When AutoCook finishes a dish that needs cooking, the character puts it in the nearest free and powered oven (or microwave, if it has no metal) within the radius and turns it on with the timer set: it turns off by itself once the dish is cooked and before it can burn.
